questions.question: The Preamble of the Constitution was amended by the ______ Constitutional Amendment Act.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**42ⁿd**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• The Preamble of the Constitution was amended by the **42ⁿd Constitutional Amendment Act**.
 
• The Preamble of the Constitution was amended **only once and it was in 1976**.
 
• The Forty-second Amendment(42ⁿd) of the constitution is also known as the "**Mini Constitution**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• This made drastic changes in the constitution:
 
 
• Changed the description of India from a "sovereign democratic republic" to a "**sovereign, socialist secular democratic republic**".
 
• Changed the words "unity of the nation" to "**unity** and **integrity** of the nation".
 
• Added a list of ten **fundamental duties** by adding Part IV-A.
 
• Added part XIV-A.
 
• Increased the tenure of Lok Sabha and state legislative assemblies from 5 years to 6, but it was canceled by 44thamendment act​
 
• Made the President bound by the advice of the cabinet.
 
 
 
• Amendment was passed during the Indira Gandhi government.
 
 
• Indira Gandhi constituted **Swaran Singh Committee** to study about amending the constitution in 1976.
 
• Recommendations of the Swaran Singh committee made several changes to the Constitution including the Preamble, through the Forty-second Amendment of the Constitution of India.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **44th amendment** removed the Right to property from the list of fundamental rights and made it only legal right.

questions.question: _________ are often referred to as the amphibians of the plant kingdom.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option **1** i.e __**Bryophyta**__.

**Explanation:**

 
• Bryophytes are often referred to as the amphibians of the plant kingdom.
 
• Bryophytes are small, non-vascular plants.
 
• The reproduction of Bryophytes is via **spores**.
 
• Bryophytes live in the soil, even though they need water for **sexual reproduction** this is the **reason why the Bryophytes are often referred to as the amphibians of the plant kingdom.**
 
• Bryophytes are generally classified into three coordinate phyla namely **the liverworts, hornworts, and mosses.**

 
 

 Phanerogamae 
 
 
 
• Plants that have seeds are called Phanerogamae.
 
• Also called **Spermatophytes**.
 
• Classified into two: Gymnosperms (naked seed plants) and Angiosperms (covered seed plants).
 
 
 
 

 Pteridophyta
 
 
 
• Vascular plant that disperses spores.
 
• Reproduce by releasing spores rather than seeds.
 
 
 
 

 Thallophyta
 
 
 
• Thallophyta included the algae, bacteria, fungi, and lichens.
 
• Autotrophic in nature.
 
• The reproductive system is hidden.

questions.question: Which of the following statements is false about Goods and Services Tax

options.text: Goods and Services Tax would not be an expense to the retail sellers and therefore there is no hidden taxes.

• GST ends the far-reaching effect of the tax.
 
• GST resolved disputes related to the classification of goods and services.
 
 
 
• GST Council is the governing body of GST.
 
 
• **Article 279 A** deals with the formation of the GST council.
 
• Union Finance Minister is the chairperson of the GST council.
 
• **Nirmala Sitharaman** is the current chairperson of the GST council.
 
 
 
• **France** is the first country to introduce GST.
 
• Different tax slabs for collection of tax under GST are **0%, 5%, 12%, 18% and 28%**.
